contribution.position: My position is unchanged: on reliability grounds this change is not in a good place right now. The authoritative perf report (artifact:perf-report) shows p99 latency of 410ms at peak load — 64% over the 250ms budget — and I note the QA turn cited 180ms, which contradicts the artifact text and does not reflect the recorded evidence. Combined with two recent sev2 retry-storm incidents (artifact:incident-log), a failure mode that excess latency under load aggravates, the reliability evidence points against shipping in the current state. The green test suite (artifact:test-report) confirms functional correctness but says nothing about behavior under load. The latency regression should be understood or mitigated before this proceeds.
